text: 1) Non-Chinese citizens who are physically and mentally healthy, have good academic background, consciously abide by Chinese laws and university rules and regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people.(2) Foreign citizens with the same academic qualifications as high school graduates and valid passports, 18-25 years old, under 18 years old need to submit a guardian guarantee. The relevant provisions of the Ministry of Education shall apply to those who were originally Chinese citizens and then acquired foreign nationality
